name: Philippines
fact: The Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park protects extraordinary marine biodiversity, housing nearly half of the world's coral species across its pristine underwater atolls.

name: Qatar
fact: Doha's Museum of Islamic Art showcases fourteen centuries of exquisite artistry from three continents within a striking limestone landmark along the waterfront promenade.

name: Saudi Arabia
fact: Carved into desert sandstone cliffs, the ancient Nabataean monumental tombs at Hegra stand preserved as the kingdom's first designated UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Singapore
fact: Over forty percent of the island is blanketed in lush green spaces, earning this vibrant city-state global acclaim as a pioneer in biophilic urban design.

name: South Korea
fact: Created in the fifteenth century, the Korean alphabet Hangul is celebrated globally for its scientific phonetic design and remarkable ease of learning.

name: Sri Lanka
capital: Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte (legislative; Colombo executive, judicial)
fact: Rising dramatically above surrounding forests, the ancient rock citadel of Sigiriya showcases brilliant fifth-century hydraulic engineering, fresco art, and landscaped water gardens.

name: Syria
fact: Cultivated for centuries around Damascus, the fragrant Damascene rose is prized worldwide by master perfumers for its exquisite, pure essential oil.

name: Taiwan
fact: Originating in Taichung tea rooms during the 1980s, Taiwanese bubble tea has blossomed into a beloved global culinary phenomenon enjoyed across continents.

name: Tajikistan
fact: High in the Pamir Mountains, Tajik National Park encompasses over two million hectares of spectacular glaciated terrain that shelters endangered snow leopards and rare mountain wildlife.

name: Thailand
fact: Recognized by UNESCO on its Intangible Cultural Heritage list, traditional Nuad Thai massage combines acupressure and gentle stretching as a time-honored therapeutic healing art.

name: Timor-Leste
fact: Surveys of the pristine reefs surrounding Atauro Island revealed the highest marine biodiversity on Earth, confirming the nation as a premier global sanctuary for coral conservation.

name: Turkey
fact: Ancient volcanic landscapes in Cappadocia form a wonderland of honeycomb hills and towering fairy chimneys, admired worldwide by hot-air balloonists gliding over the lunar valleys.

name: Turkmenistan
fact: Prized for their lustrous golden coats and exceptional stamina across harsh deserts, purebred Akhal-Teke horses represent one of the world's oldest and most admired equine breeds.

name: United Arab Emirates
fact: With the historic launch of its Hope probe, the nation became the first Arab country to place an interplanetary robotic spacecraft into orbit around Mars.

name: Uzbekistan
fact: The ancient Silk Road crossroads of Samarkand dazzles travelers with the grand Registan plaza, celebrated for its soaring madrasas and brilliant azure mosaic tiles.

name: Vietnam
fact: Hidden beneath Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park, magnificent Son Doong Cave is so cavernous that its largest chamber could comfortably house a forty-story skyscraper city block.

name: Yemen
fact: Isolated in the Indian Ocean, Socotra Island nurtures hundreds of rare endemic plants, including the legendary dragon's blood tree with its distinctive umbrella-shaped canopy.
